transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. It's been like this for months now. Some days I just pick at some toast and have coffee, and then other days... I'll find myself standing in the bakery aisle buying sweets that I don't even really enjoy. It's just been very all over the place.
After eating like that, do you ever make yourself throw up?
No, no I don't do that. I've never tried to make myself sick or anything like that. I just... I eat it and then I just feel bad about it afterwards. But no, I don't throw up.
During those times when you are eating sweets or large amounts of food, do you feel like you can't stop or control how much you're eating?
No, I wouldn't say I feel out of control. I know I'm doing it, and I know I could stop if I really wanted to. It's just... I just kind of keep eating them anyway. But I don't feel like I can't stop.
Aside from your eating, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless lately?

Yes, I have. Most days, actually. I just wake up with this heavy, sad feeling kind of sitting on me. Even when I'm in my bright kitchen with the coffee going... I just feel like the warmth has completely gone out of everything.
Have you ever had a period like this in the past where you felt depressed or down for weeks at a time?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, like anyone, but... not like this. Not where it just stays with me for weeks on end. This is the first time I've felt this down for this long.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

Yeah, I have. I used to get pretty excited about working on my quilting squares, or going to bowling night. I always liked planning potlucks, too. But now... I don't know, I just look at my sewing supplies or the church calendar, and I can't make myself care the way I used to. It's just not there.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt unusually energized, hyper, or on top of the world, needing much less sleep than usual?
No, I can't say I have. I've never really been a hyper person, or felt... on top of the world like that. And I've always needed my regular amount of sleep. So, no, nothing like that.
